newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Australia to face Spain at home in Fed Cup.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Australia to face Spain at home in Fed Cup.

text.p: Australia will face Spain at home in July in the women's Fed Cup world group one play-off match, officials said on Friday.
By winning home advantage in a toss of the coin, Australia will avoid playing Spain on clay, their favoured court surface.
The Spanish women, led by Arantxa Sanchez Vicario, have won the Cup four times in the last six years, with three of those successes gained on clay.
Australian Fed Cup spokeswoman Wendy Hooper said the tie would be played on either grass or hardcourt.
The venue and choice of playing surface will be announced on April 14, she said.
Australia qualified for the play-off by beating South Africa in an away tie earlier this month, while the powerful Spanish suffered an upset loss to Belgium.
If they beat Spain, Australia will play next year in the eight-strong elite world group one, from which the Cup winner will emerge.
